requirement:
The harness MUST record the sources it supplies to the model, including
mandatory inputs, additional reads, and selected search dependencies under
{cite}`requirements.authoring.finish_search.inputs`, using the evidence input formats
defined by {cite}`requirements.ci.outline_inputs`,
{cite}`requirements.ci.requirements_inputs`, and
{cite}`requirements.definitions.inputs`. The harness MUST create these records
itself so ordinary evidence validation can check them later.
rationale:
The marked tests cover each obligation in `requirements.authoring.delivered_inputs`.

**Mandatory inputs.**
- `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[stdout_emits_only_evidence_json_without_changing_project_files]` checks that the written evidence holds a requirements input for the subject, a definition input for `terms.readiness`, and outline inputs under `src/lib.rs`.
- The same test checks that the evidence has exactly the schema's fields.
- It checks that every outline input carries only `file`, `item` and `hash`, with no source text.
- `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[implementation_discovery_has_no_text_or_evidence_until_the_model_requests_a_read]` checks that only the read item is recorded, and recorded once.
- `src/authoring/mod.rs#mod[tests]/fn[throttled_requests_retry_unchanged_and_record_every_attempt]` asserts that the evidence `inputs` equal `sources.mandatory_inputs()`. It has no `{test}` reference to this requirement. That is a marking gap only, and the marked tests already cover the obligation.

**Additional reads.**
- `src/authoring/tools.rs#mod[tests]/fn[reading_records_only_delivered_sources_and_their_terms]` checks that recording happens only through `record_inputs`, and that repeated delivery is deduplicated.
- It also checks that a recorded outline input equals `crate::inputs::outline_input`, and that a read adds the terms it needs.
- It checks that failed reads and `list_files` record nothing.
- `fn[line_range_reads_record_the_innermost_covering_nodes]` checks line-range reads recorded as outline inputs by selector and hash, with no line numbers or text. It covers nested nodes and plain-text line nodes.
- `fn[declaration_text_reaches_the_model_redacted]` checks the requirements and definition input formats. For a requirements input it checks `requirements`, sorted `matches`, and full-order `text` joined with blank lines. For a definition input it checks `definition` and `text`. It also checks that the recorded inputs equal the delivered input plus its definitions.

**Selected search dependencies.**
- `src/authoring/searches.rs#mod[tests]/fn[selected_dependencies_keep_the_delivered_hash_and_accumulate_without_reads]` covers this. A file is mutated after delivery, and the recorded input still carries the delivered hash.
- Validating that input reports a hash error, so the old hash was kept.
- Unselected entries are not recorded.
- Repeated tags are deduplicated.
- No read is needed for the recording.
- `src/authoring/mod.rs#mod[tests]/fn[a_helper_used_only_through_a_search_snippet_invalidates_saved_evidence_when_weakened]` checks that a helper selected only via `finish_search`, with no `habeas` read, is recorded. It also checks that the record validates while the file is unchanged and fails on a hash mismatch after the helper is weakened.

**Only delivered sources are recorded.**
- `src/authoring/mod.rs#mod[tests]/fn[only_inputs_on_delivered_pages_are_recorded]` checks that only entries on delivered pages are recorded, and that undelivered ones are not.
- `src/authoring/pages.rs#mod[tests]/fn[paged_inputs_carry_their_definitions_and_deliver_only_their_own_inputs]` checks that a page's inputs are exactly its own inputs and definitions.

**Created by the harness, and valid under ordinary validation.**
- `src/authoring/sdk.rs#mod[tests]/fn[confirmed_evidence_retains_reads_from_both_assessments_and_the_verifier]` checks that reads from both assessments and the verifier are retained in the evidence record.
- `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[ollama_cli_delivers_sources_records_fixme_and_keeps_usage_content_free]` runs `validate_repository` on the written evidence and finds no error for it. A tampered determination does fail validation, so the check is real.

Delegation: the validation behaviour of the cited input formats belongs to the cited requirements, so I did not reassess it.

I found no gap in the assertions.

text: :::{req} delivered_inputs
The harness MUST record the sources it supplies to the model, including
mandatory inputs, additional reads, and selected search dependencies under
{cite}`requirements.authoring.finish_search.inputs`, using the evidence input formats
defined by {cite}`requirements.ci.outline_inputs`,
{cite}`requirements.ci.requirements_inputs`, and
{cite}`requirements.definitions.inputs`. The harness MUST create these records
itself so ordinary evidence validation can check them later.
:::{req} finish_search.inputs
For each tag selected by a valid `finish_search` call, the harness MUST record
its `file`, `item`, and structural hash as an outline input under
{cite}`requirements.ci.outline_inputs` before acknowledging that call.
:::{req} outline_inputs
For an outline input, Habeas MUST parse `file` with its language's grammar under
{cite}`requirements.references.outlines` and resolve `item` to exactly one
outline node under {cite}`requirements.references.outline_selectors`. It MUST
compare `hash` with the node's current structural hash under
{cite}`requirements.references.structural_hash`. It MUST derive the node's
inclusive line range, including attached comments and attributes, during
validation for display and reference coverage. Moving the node, editing other
nodes, or editing comments its profile does not hash MUST NOT invalidate the
input. Habeas MUST report a missing file, parse failure,
invalid or ambiguous selector, or changed hash.
:::{req} requirements_inputs

For a requirements input, `requirements` MUST be a {term}`requirements.references.definition_selection`, and Habeas MUST match it against all defined requirements and named examples. It MUST recompute the matches during validation, sort their full names, and compare them with `matches`. It MUST take each match's complete raw fenced declaration, including its opening and closing lines, concatenate those declarations in full-name order with one blank line between them, and compare the resulting raw lines with `text`. It MUST retain every match's current source file and inclusive line range for display and reference coverage. A selection matching no definitions MUST be invalid. Adding, removing, renaming, or changing a matched definition MUST invalidate the stored input; moving an unchanged declaration within the book MUST NOT. Errors MUST identify the selection and affected definitions when available.
:::{req} inputs

Evidence inputs MAY have a definition form containing exactly `definition` and `text`. `definition` MUST identify one named definition; `text` MUST contain its complete raw fenced declaration as source lines, including its phrase option and explanatory body.

Validation MUST reject missing definitions and changed snapshot text, identifying the definition and showing a compact diff when available. Moving an unchanged definition within its chapter MUST NOT invalidate its snapshot. Evidence displays MUST show the definition name, current source location, and recorded text.
:::{definition} definition_selection
:phrase: definition selection
A full requirement or example name, or a definition glob, identifying the
requirements and named examples it matches under
{cite}`requirements.references.definition_globs`. A name without `*` selects
exactly that definition.
